carrying-capacity.def: The largest population of a species that an environment can support over time with its food, water, space and other resources. Written K. It can change when the environment changes.

overshoot.def: The state of a population that has grown larger than the carrying capacity of its environment, so it uses resources faster than they are replaced.

dieback.def: A sharp drop in a population after overshoot, as individuals starve, sicken or fail to reproduce because resources have run short. Also called a population crash.
